title: ‘Kids Are Dying. How Are These Sites Still Allowed?’

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日时事通讯 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场采访一些在商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载

sentences.en: New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: A quick note.
sentences.zh: 温馨提示。

sentences.en: Today's episode covers suicide and contains details about suicide deaths.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目涉及自杀话题，并包含有关自杀身亡的细节。

sentences.en: If you're having thoughts of suicide or are concerned that someone you know may be having those thoughts, the number for the National Suicide Prevention
sentences.zh: 如果您有自杀的想法，或者担心您认识的人可能有这种想法，全国自杀预防

sentences.en: Lifeline is 1-800-273-8255.
And there are links to additional resources in today's show notes.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目简介中也提供了指向其他资源的链接。

sentences.en: Let me tell you a little bit about me.
sentences.zh: 让我向您简单介绍一下我自己。

sentences.en: I've been working on this story with a reporting partner, somebody named Gabriel Dance.
sentences.zh: 我一直与一位报道搭档——一个名叫加布里埃尔·丹斯的人——共同致力于这个故事的报道。

sentences.en: We are both reporters in the investigations unit at the
sentences.zh: 我们都是

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》调查部的记者。

sentences.en: And so...
sentences.zh: 所以……

sentences.en: Today on The Daily.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: So Megan and I have been looking specifically at a site where they say, you know, they want to be a place where people can speak freely about suicide.
sentences.zh: 所以，梅根和我一直在专门调查一个网站，他们说，你知道的，他们希望成为一个让人们可以自由谈论自杀的地方。

sentences.en: A Times investigation.
sentences.zh: 这是一项《纽约时报》的调查。

sentences.en: We've been working to identify the people who run the site and some...
sentences.zh: 我们一直在努力确定运营该网站的人员以及一些……

sentences.en: ...into a website that facilitates suicide.
sentences.zh: ……关于一个助长自杀的网站的调查。

sentences.en: We think that quite a few accountable parties should explain why a site like this is allowed to stay up.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，相当多的负有责任的各方应该解释，为什么这样一个网站被允许继续存在。

sentences.en: And what is your biggest concern about the website from what you've learned about it since?
sentences.zh: 从你后来了解到的情况来看，你对这个网站最大的担忧是什么？

sentences.en: Church.
sentences.zh: 丘奇。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleagues, Megan Toohey and Gabriel Dance, about why the site is so uniquely
sentences.zh: 我与我的同事梅根·图伊和加布里埃尔·丹斯进行了交谈，探讨了为什么这个网站如此独特地

sentences.en: dangerous and why it's proven so difficult to shut down.
sentences.zh: 危险，以及为什么事实证明它如此难以被关闭。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, December 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月9日，星期四。

sentences.en: Megan,
sentences.zh: 梅根，

sentences.en: Gabriel, tell me about this investigation that you have both been working on.
sentences.zh: 加布里埃尔，跟我讲讲你们两个一直在进行的这项调查吧。

sentences.en: So we've been reporting on a website that deals with suicide that was launched a few years ago when the suicide rate among young people in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在报道一个关于自杀的网站，该网站几年前在美国年轻人自杀率达到

sentences.en: was at a historic high.
sentences.zh: 历史最高水平时上线。

sentences.en: The site gets 6 million views each month with viewers from around the world.
sentences.zh: 该网站每个月有600万次浏览量，观众来自世界各地。

sentences.en: You know, that's four times as many views as the National Suicide Prevention website gets.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这比国家自杀预防网站的浏览量多出四倍。

sentences.en: So it's got a significant reach.
sentences.zh: 因此，它的影响力相当大。

sentences.en: And our reporting shows that this website is a really dangerous place.
sentences.zh: 我们的报道表明，这个网站是一个非常危险的地方。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that members post anonymously, Megan and I have been able to identify 45 people who killed themselves after spending time on the site, several of whom were minors.
sentences.zh: 尽管成员都是匿名发帖，但梅根和我还是成功识别出了45名在花时间浏览该网站后自杀身亡的人，其中几人是未成年人。

sentences.en: And after analyzing more than a million posts, we found that the true number of deaths is likely far higher, like hundreds more.
sentences.zh: 在分析了超过一百万条帖子后，我们发现真实的死亡人数可能要高得多，还要多出几百人。

sentences.en: Well, before we go any further, I have to ask, can't it also be dangerous to do what we're doing right now, which is to publish stories about suicide?
sentences.zh: 好吧，在我们深入探讨之前，我必须问一句，做我们现在正在做的事情——也就是发表关于自杀的报道——难道不也很危险吗？

sentences.en: So how did you grapple with that?
sentences.zh: 所以你们是如何应对这一问题的？

sentences.en: Yes, there's a concern that media coverage of suicide can lead people to harm themselves.
sentences.zh: 是的，人们担心媒体对自杀的报道会导致人们伤害自己。

sentences.en: And so we consulted with many suicide experts and debated that.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们咨询了许多自杀专家并进行了辩论。

sentences.en: And in the end, the Times concluded that the stakes were so high that we had an obligation to tell this story.
sentences.zh: 最后，《时报》得出结论，事态极其重大，我们有义务讲述这个故事。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for taking some more time to talk to me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您抽出更多时间跟我交谈。

sentences.en: Not least of all, because we talked to so many parents who had no idea that this site existed, let alone that their kids were on it, until it was too late.
sentences.zh: 其中一个重要原因在于，我们采访了许多父母，直到为时已晚，他们才知道这个网站的存在，更不用说他们的孩子一直在上面了。

sentences.en: One of those parents is a woman named Sharon Luft.
sentences.zh: 这些父母中有一位名叫莎朗·勒夫的女士。

sentences.en: She lives outside of Dallas.
sentences.zh: 她住在达拉斯郊外。

sentences.en: And she told us about her 17-year-old son, Matthew.
sentences.zh: 她向我们讲述了她17岁的儿子马修的故事。

sentences.en: So I wanted to just circle back about, you know, your experience and what happened with
sentences.zh: 所以我想回过头来谈谈，你知道的，你的经历以及发生在

sentences.en: Matthew, because he is so young.
sentences.zh: 马修身上的事，因为他还那么年轻。

sentences.en: And if you're willing to just talk to me a little bit more about him.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意再跟我多聊聊他。

sentences.en: Did he come out to his friends?
sentences.zh: 他有向朋友们出柜吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I talk to him a lot.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我和他聊了很多。

sentences.en: And he's like, Mom, kids our age don't care anymore.
sentences.zh: 他说，妈妈，我们这个年纪的孩子已经不在乎了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They don't.
sentences.zh: 他们确实不在乎。

sentences.en: He was applying to college.
sentences.zh: 他当时在申请大学。

sentences.en: He wanted to become a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 他想成为一名律师。

sentences.en: And he's like, well, I want to go to law school and I just want to become a public defender.
sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，我想去法学院，然后我想成为一名公设辩护人。

sentences.en: I'm like, oh, God, no.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，天哪，不。

sentences.en: That's what I want to do.
sentences.zh: 那是我想做的事。

sentences.en: I want to help.
sentences.zh: 我想去帮忙。

sentences.en: He was excited about it.
sentences.zh: 他对此感到很兴奋。

sentences.en: So
sentences.zh: 所以

sentences.en: it was like, said he didn't feel like dinner.
sentences.zh: 就好像，他说他感觉晚饭吃不下了。

sentences.en: His tummy didn't feel so.
sentences.zh: 他的胃感觉不太……

sentences.en: I said to him, don't.
sentences.zh: 我对他说，别这样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It was very contorted.
sentences.zh: 当时他的身体非常扭曲。

sentences.en: And he was on his bed.
sentences.zh: 他正躺在自己的床上。

sentences.en: And what's going on?
sentences.zh: 怎么回事？

sentences.en: He was just sick.
sentences.zh: 他只是生病了。

sentences.en: You thought that he had died from being sick?
sentences.zh: 你以为他是因为生病而死的？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Natural causes.
sentences.zh: 自然死亡。

sentences.en: I thought he had a stomach.
sentences.zh: 我以为他得了胃病。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: The site, he's like, I didn't know Matthew was on that.
sentences.zh: 那个网站，他说，我不知道马修在看那个。

sentences.en: He was aware of the suicide website.
sentences.zh: 他知道那个自杀网站。

sentences.en: Very much.
sentences.zh: 非常清楚。

sentences.en: So Megan and Gabriel, what can you say about this site that Matthew was on?
sentences.zh: 那么梅根和加布里埃尔，关于马修访问过的这个网站，你们能说些什么？

sentences.en: So the site is called Sanctioned Suicide.
sentences.zh: 这个网站名叫“制裁自杀”。

sentences.en: It launched in 2018 after Reddit banned a suicide forum on its site, saying that members routinely shared methods and encouraged each other to harm themselves.
sentences.zh: 它于2018年上线，此前 Reddit 封禁了其网站上的一个自杀论坛，称成员们经常分享方法并鼓励彼此伤害。

sentences.en: So when that happened, two guys who were familiar with the forum decided that they were going to start their own independent suicide website.
sentences.zh: 所以在那种情况下，两个熟悉该论坛的家伙决定创办他们自己的独立自杀网站。

sentences.en: And this was going to be a site where people could come and they could speak freely and openly and without fear of any kind of censorship.
sentences.zh: 这将是一个人们可以前来、可以自由公开地发言而不用担心任何形式审查的网站。

sentences.en: And over the next few years, as more and more people started making their way to the site,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，随着越来越多的人开始涌向这个网站，

sentences.en: it became clear that the community that was attracted to this kind of open forum was vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 很明显，被这种开放论坛吸引的群体是脆弱的。

sentences.en: I mean, we've read thousands and thousands of posts.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们已经阅读了成千上万条帖子。

sentences.en: And we have seen a lot of people describing histories of mental illness.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了很多人描述的精神疾病史。

sentences.en: It's also obvious that many of them are young.
sentences.zh: 同样显而易见的是，他们中的许多人都很年轻。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: According to a survey, the site conducted itself, almost half the users are under the age of 25.
sentences.zh: 根据该网站自己进行的一项调查，近一半的用户年龄在25岁以下。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And what do those people find when they arrive at this site?
sentences.zh: 那么这些人到达这个网站时发现了什么？

sentences.en: So, you know, I don't know where you feel comfortable starting to tell me about kind of how you first came to this site and what your experience was like.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我不知道你觉得从哪里开始讲述你最初是如何来到这个网站的以及你的经历是怎样的比较合适。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I...
sentences.zh: 所以我就……

sentences.en: When we talked to people who have spent time there...
sentences.zh: 当我们与那些在那里度过时间的人交谈时……

sentences.en: It just comes up in search results and it's like on the first page, it comes up.
sentences.zh: 它就会出现在搜索结果里，就像在第一页上，它就会跳出来。

sentences.en: They said it was very easy to find.
sentences.zh: 他们说这非常容易找到。

sentences.en: Did you have...
sentences.zh: 你当时有……

sentences.en: How did you feel about the way that the sort of site was constructed and did you feel...
sentences.zh: 你对这种网站的构建方式有什么感觉，你是否觉得……

sentences.en: And it functions a lot like social media platforMs.
sentences.zh: 它的运作方式很像社交媒体平台。

sentences.en: Like Facebook, there's a little notification bell at the top.
sentences.zh: 就像 Facebook 一样，顶部有一个小通知铃铛。

sentences.en: You receive likes and hearts and other emojis depending on what you post on there.
sentences.zh: 根据你在上面发布的内容，你会收到点赞、爱心和其他表情符号。

sentences.en: ...and a hierarchy and you knew the members that were really popular and that were really active.
sentences.zh: ……还有阶层，你知道哪些成员非常受欢迎，非常活跃。

sentences.en: People are ranked by the number of reactions they get.
sentences.zh: 人们根据他们得到的反应数量进行排名。

sentences.en: It felt slick.
sentences.zh: 它看起来很光滑流畅。

sentences.en: It felt moderated.
sentences.zh: 它感觉受到过版主管理。

sentences.en: I would just be on that site all the time.
sentences.zh: 我整天都会泡在这个网站上。

sentences.en: Constantly.
sentences.zh: 不间断地。

sentences.en: I was so addicted to it, like...
sentences.zh: 我对它如此上瘾，就像……

sentences.en: The site really draws people in.
sentences.zh: 这个网站确实把人们吸引进去了。

sentences.en: Oh, I was totally addicted.
sentences.zh: 哦，我完全上瘾了。

sentences.en: But of course, this is not like any other platform.
sentences.zh: 但当然，这与其他任何平台都不同。

sentences.en: This is a website about suicide.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于自杀的网站。

sentences.en: And while there are some earnest conversations about hope and recovery, and people can find links to some resources to help,
sentences.zh: 虽然有一些关于希望和康复的真诚对话，人们也可以找到一些帮助资源的链接，

sentences.en: it's clear that the posts that are getting the most attention are the kinds of things that are very difficult to find anywhere else on the internet.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，获得最多关注的帖子是那些在互联网其他任何地方都很难找到的内容。

sentences.en: It's not just people talking about wanting to die.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是人们在谈论想要死去。

sentences.en: It's people talking at great length about how they're going to do it and sharing step-by-step instructions.
sentences.zh: 而是人们在大篇幅地讨论他们将如何去死，并分享分步指南。

sentences.en: And in the public forums, the live chats, and through private messaging, they often get advice and support as they make their plans.
sentences.zh: 在公开论坛、实时聊天以及通过私信中，他们在制定计划时经常会获得建议和支持。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Now, when we talked with some of the foremost suicide experts in the country, they were just aghast that these types of conversations are happening
sentences.zh: 现在，当我们与国内一些最顶尖的自杀专家交谈时，他们对这类对话正在发生

sentences.en: and that they're happening on a site that's getting so much traffic.
sentences.zh: 且发生在一个流量如此巨大的网站上感到无比震惊。

sentences.en: They told us that suicidal thoughts are often temporary and that people can and do get through them, but that they're much more likely to go through with their plans
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我们，自杀的想法通常是暂时的，人们能够而且确实能挺过去，但如果他们了解了方法并确信这是正确的事情，他们就更有可能把计划付诸行动，

sentences.en: if they learn about methods and become convinced it's the right thing to do,
sentences.zh: 而这正是这个网站上正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: which is exactly what happens on this site.
sentences.zh: 以莎朗的儿子马修为例。

sentences.en: Take Sharon's son, Matthew.
sentences.zh: 当他在去年12月加入时，他做的第一件事就是询问某种特定方法。

sentences.en: When he joined last December, one of the first things he did was to ask about a particular method.
sentences.zh: 他在一则帖子中写道：

sentences.en: He wrote in a post,
sentences.zh: 所以，我是这里的新人，一直盯着 SN 方法不放。

sentences.en: So, I'm new around here and have been eyeing the SN method.
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: And what is that?
sentences.zh: 那是亚硝酸钠的简称。

sentences.en: So, it's short for sodium nitrite.
sentences.zh: 它是一种用于腌制肉类的防腐剂。

sentences.en: It's a preservative that's used to cure meat.
sentences.zh: 它在网上买得到，有些人用它来结束自己的生命。

sentences.en: It's available online and some people have used it to kill themselves.
sentences.zh: 这种方法如此阴险的原因，也是我们将其纳入报道的原因，在于我们交谈过的许多人——

sentences.en: And what is so insidious about this method, and the reason we're including it in our story at all, is that many of the people we spoke with,
sentences.zh: 父母、心理健康专家、法医，甚至警察，都不知道它被用作这种用途。

sentences.en: parents, mental health professionals, medical examiners, even the police, had no idea it was being used in this way.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，它已成为该网站上讨论最多的方法。

sentences.en: And at the same time, it's become the most discussed method on this website.
sentences.zh: 那么，在马修询问这种方法后发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, what happened after Matthew asked about this method?
sentences.zh: 几乎立刻，另一名成员就带着如何使用它来死亡的详细说明链接凑了过来。

sentences.en: Almost immediately, another member swooped in with a link to detailed instructions on how to use it to die.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，我们可以看到马修继续与其他成员讨论在他自杀时应该听什么音乐。

sentences.en: Over the next few weeks, we could see that Matthew went on to talk to other members about what music to listen to as he killed himself.
sentences.zh: 他思索着他死后会发生什么。

sentences.en: He contemplated what would happen after he died.
sentences.zh: 到了今年1月，也就是马修首次登录该网站还不到一个月的时候，我们看到他在另外两名成员的帖子下留言，而这两名成员实际上正在积极记录

sentences.en: And by January of this year, less than a month after Matthew first signed on to the site, we saw him post on the threads of two other members who were actually actively documenting
sentences.zh: 他们的自杀过程。

sentences.en: their own suicide attempts using the same method Matthew was considering.
sentences.zh: 他们自己采用马修正在考虑的同一种方法尝试自杀。

sentences.en: He told one of them, good luck.
sentences.zh: 他告诉其中一个人，祝你好运。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And that same afternoon,
sentences.zh: 就在那天下午，

sentences.en: Matthew posted,
sentences.zh: 马修发帖称，

sentences.en: seeking specific advice,
sentences.zh: 寻求具体建议，

sentences.en: because he said he wanted to make sure that when he decided to kill himself, he would not fail.
sentences.zh: 因为他说他想确保当他决定自杀时，不会失败。

sentences.zh: 就在第二天晚上，他告诉他妈妈说他胃疼。

sentences.en: After that, he went up to his room, logged onto the site, and started his own thread.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，他走回房间，登录了网站，并开启了自己的主题帖。

sentences.en: And, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，

sentences.en: I'm looking at the thread.
sentences.zh: 我在看这个帖子。

sentences.en: He said, so ladies and gents, it's finally happening.
sentences.zh: 他说，各位先生女士，这终于要发生了。

sentences.en: You know, as if he was inviting people to a performance of some kind.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就好像他在邀请人们观看某种表演一样。

sentences.en: And the members who were reading flooded him with emojis and other messages of support, letting him know, we're here, we're with you, we support you.
sentences.zh: 那些阅读帖子的会员们向他涌去了大量的表情符号和其他支持的信息，让他知道，我们在这里，我们和你在一起，我们支持你。

sentences.en: And over the next 34 minutes, he essentially live-blogged his own death.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的34分钟里，他基本上是在实况直播自己的死亡。

sentences.en: And these other members continued to respond to him every step of the way.
sentences.zh: 而这些其他成员在整个过程中的每一步都继续回应他。

sentences.en: At one point,
sentences.zh: 有一刻，

sentences.zh: 马修想知道这个方法是否奏效，并问他是否应该继续下去。

sentences.en: And another member responded, if you want the attempt to be a success, then yes.
sentences.zh: 另一个成员回应说，如果你想让自杀成功，那就继续。

sentences.en: And these exchanges went on until finally Matthew went silent.
sentences.zh: 这些交流一直在继续，直到最后马修彻底沉默了。

sentences.en: We've seen a lot of threads, like the one Matthew wrote that night.
sentences.zh: 我们看过很多这样的帖子，就像马修那天晚上写的那样。

sentences.en: On the site, they are known as goodbye threads.
sentences.zh: 在该网站上，它们被称为告别帖。

sentences.en: And there have been over 500 members who have posted these types of messages

sentences.en: and then never posted again.
sentences.zh: 然后就再也没有发过帖。

sentences.en: After everything that you have both just laid out,
sentences.zh: 听了你们刚才所阐述的一切之后，

sentences.en: I'm struggling to understand how it's possible that this website is still up and running.
sentences.zh: 我很难理解这个网站怎么可能还在运营。

sentences.en: That's a good question.
sentences.zh: 这是个好问题。

sentences.en: And it's one that we have heard a lot throughout the course of our reporting.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们在整个报道过程中经常听到的一個问题。

sentences.en: The answer really begins with the two men behind the site.
sentences.zh: 答案其实要从该网站背后的两个男人说起。

sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: So, Megan and Gabriel, tell me about these two men who created this site.
sentences.zh: 那么，梅根和加布里埃尔，跟我讲讲创建这个网站的这两个人吧。

sentences.en: That's actually taken us a long time to piece together.
sentences.zh: 这其实花拉了我们很长时间才拼凑起来。

sentences.en: You know, they're known on the website by their usernames,
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们在网站上以用户名为人所知，

sentences.en: Markey and Sarge, but they've left very few clues about who they really are, which obviously makes it difficult for them to be held accountable.
sentences.zh: 马基（Markey）和萨奇（Sarge），但他们留下了极少关于他们真实身份的线索，这显然给追究他们的责任带来了困难。

sentences.en: So, Megan and I set out to find them.
sentences.zh: 所以，我和梅根着手寻找他们。

sentences.en: And how exactly did you go about doing that?
sentences.zh: 你们具体是怎么做的呢？

sentences.en: Well, pretty early on, we saw this 2019 BuzzFeed article that gave us a good place to start.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很早以前，我们就看到了2019年的一篇《BuzzFeed》文章，它给我们提供了一个很好的起点。

sentences.en: It said that in addition to the suicide site,
sentences.zh: 文章称，除了这个自杀网站外，

sentences.en: Markey and Sarge also ran several prominent websites for incels.
sentences.zh: 马基和萨奇还运营着几个著名的非自愿独身者（incel）网站。

sentences.en: And remind me what it means to be an incel.
sentences.zh: 提醒我一下，非自愿独身者是什么意思。

sentences.en: It's a term that means involuntary celibate.
sentences.zh: 这是一个意思是“非自愿独身”的词。

sentences.en: And the people who call themselves this are generally men who believe that women will never have sex with them because of their looks and their social status.
sentences.zh: 自称如此的人通常是那些认为女性永远不会因为他们的外表和社群地位而与他们发生性关系的男性。

sentences.en: A lot of them express anger and sadness about this and believe that there's nothing they can do to change their circumstances.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人对此表示愤怒和悲伤，并认为他们无力改变自己的处境。

sentences.en: And so many in this community see suicide as a justifiable option.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个社群中的许多人将自杀视为一种合理的选择。

sentences.en: So what did you do once you found out that Markey and Sarge ran several incel websites?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你发现马基和萨奇运营了几个非自愿独身者网站后，你们做了什么？

sentences.en: Well, knowing that they ran these websites gave us a lot more leads.
sentences.zh: 嗯，知道他们运营这些网站给了我们更多的线索。

sentences.en: And when we started looking around the incel world, we could see that they were pretty vocal members in that community.
sentences.zh: 当我们开始审视非自愿独身者的世界时，我们可以看到他们是该社群中相当直言不讳的成员。

sentences.en: Earlier this year,
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，

sentences.en: Sarge took part in an online panel discussion.
sentences.zh: 萨奇参加了一场在线小组讨论。

sentences.en: If people come to the forum incels.co, it is mainly because they want to be somewhere where they won't be told, hey, hey, there is a way out.
sentences.zh: 如果人们来到incels.co论坛，主要是因为他们想去一个不会被人告知“喂，喂，这里有条出路”的地方。

sentences.en: He appeared anonymously, just a black screen in his voice.
sentences.zh: 他匿名露面，只有一个黑屏和他的声音。

sentences.en: If we are being honest, not everyone has a way out.
sentences.zh: 如果我们要坦诚的话，并不是每个人都有一条出路的。

sentences.en: And he was talking about his dark outlook on life.
sentences.zh: 他当时在谈论他对生活的悲观看法。

sentences.en: So about our site, we try not to restrict what people talk about too much.
sentences.zh: 所以关于我们的网站，我们尽量不太多限制人们谈论的内容。

sentences.en: Markey's made anonymous appearances too.
sentences.zh: 马基也曾匿名露面。

sentences.en: People are going to seek out this stuff anyway.
sentences.zh: 人们无论如何都会寻找这些东西。

sentences.en: So we try to let people vent without interfering too much.
sentences.zh: 所以我们尽量让人们发泄，而不过多干涉。

sentences.en: We try not to interfere with speech.
sentences.zh: 我们尽量不干涉言论。

sentences.en: I'm a defender of freedom of speech.
sentences.zh: 我是言论自由的捍卫者。

sentences.en: He's even spoken directly about the suicide site and why he believes in it.
sentences.zh: 他甚至直接谈到了这个自杀网站以及他为什么坚信它。

sentences.en: I think many of the people that come to the site, they go out better than they came in.
sentences.zh: 我认为很多来到这个网站的人，他们离开时比来的时候状态更好。

sentences.en: You know, kind of.
sentences.zh: 你知道，差不多吧。

sentences.en: And seeing that they had done all these interviews,
sentences.zh: 看到他们做过所有这些采访后，

sentences.en: Gabe and I started calling around to see if the people they talked with knew who they were.
sentences.zh: 我和加布开始四处打电话，看他们交谈过的人是否知道他们是谁。

sentences.en: But no one knew their true identities.
sentences.zh: 但没有人知道他们的真实身份。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: They only knew
sentences.zh: 他们只知道

sentences.en: Markey and Sarge by their pseudonyMs.
sentences.zh: 马基和萨奇的化名。

sentences.en: And so we started digging into their websites and looking for paper trails.
sentences.zh: 于是我们开始深入研究他们的网站并寻找纸面线索。

sentences.en: And everywhere we looked, there was intentional misdirection.
sentences.zh: 然而我们看过的每个地方，都有故意误导的痕迹。

sentences.en: Like, we kept seeing this name in connection to the site,
sentences.zh: 比如，我们一直看到这个名字与该网站有关，

sentences.en: Randy Thompson, who apparently lived in Illinois.
sentences.zh: 兰迪·汤普森（Randy Thompson），他显然住在伊利诺伊州。

sentences.en: But when we ran that down, there was no Randy Thompson in Illinois who was running these sites.
sentences.zh: 但当我们去追查时，伊利诺伊州根本没有一个叫兰迪·汤普森的人在运营这些网站。

sentences.en: So for months, we kept digging and making calls and we actually started to home in on a couple of names, but nothing certain.
sentences.zh: 因此，几个月来，我们不断深入挖掘和打电话，我们实际上开始锁定几个名字，但没有什么确凿的。

sentences.en: And then we got a pretty big break.
sentences.zh: 然后我们迎来了一个相当大的突破。

sentences.en: And what was that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: In September of this year, an internet company got hacked.
sentences.zh: 今年9月，一家互联网公司遭到黑客攻击。

sentences.en: And that hack made all kinds of new documents available to us.
sentences.zh: 这次黑客攻击为我们提供了各种各样的新文件。

sentences.en: And in those new documents, documents that Markey and Sarge never expected to be made public, we found the names that we had been homing in on.
sentences.zh: 在这些新文件中——马基和萨奇绝没想到会被公之于众的文件中——我们找到了我们一直在锁定的名字。

sentences.en: And not just their names, like email addresses, home addresses, phone numbers, directly tying them to the incel sites and to the suicide site.
sentences.zh: 不仅是他们的名字，还有电子邮件地址、家庭住址、电话号码，直接将他们与非自愿独身者网站和自杀网站联系起来。

sentences.en: We even found a credit card invoice showing a payment for the suicide site.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至找到了一张显示支付自杀网站费用的信用卡账单。

sentences.en: And once we had that, we were able to dig up court records, police reports.
sentences.zh: 一旦有了这些，我们就能够挖掘出法庭记录、警察报告。

sentences.en: We amassed a lot of information.
sentences.zh: 我们收集了大量的信息。

sentences.en: And it all pointed to two people.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都指向两个人。

sentences.en: LaMarcus Small and Diego Galante.
sentences.zh: 拉马库斯·斯莫尔（LaMarcus Small）和迭戈·加兰特（Diego Galante）。
